run_make_cmakelists: run make_cmakelists.py with an output path argument to generate a CMakeLists.txt from BUILD and WORKSPACE files
build_cc_library_cmake: build a CMake add_library target from a Bazel cc_library rule including source and header files
convert_workspace_to_cmake: convert a Bazel WORKSPACE file into a CMake project() declaration using WorkspaceFileFunctions
add_deps_target_link: add target_link_libraries entries to CMake output by stripping colons from Bazel dependency names
generate_header_only_library: generate a CMake INTERFACE library target for Bazel cc_library rules that contain only header files
